steps: Create an isolated FastMCP stdio server with one read-only launch_status tool returning synthetic launch readiness.
Settings → MCP → Add server: name demo; command the demo environment Python; args the demo server script.
Connect and wait for 1 server, 1 tool. Capture the actual result.
In a new chat, request demo__launch_status once; actual tool card reports 5ms and the reply reflects its three readiness values.
privacy_review: Final capture does not expose the command path or credentials. Synthetic local tool; no external service.
